source_title: igawa6/Raitchi: Emulator Based on Shared Runtime of Recomp Project that run Natively using NVN Layer - GitHub
source_excerpt:
Version 0.0.2 fixes package preparation, keyboard input, driver downloads and Android packaging. See the release notes and integration notes .
Raitchi is an experimental Android launcher and shared runtime for original Nintendo Switch ARM64 games. Continuous native execution (NCE) runs the original CPU code; Horizon services and NVN-to-Vulkan graphics are implemented by a shared runtime. A separate Android frontend is derived from Eden. No per-game generated C is required for the default NCE path.
This is early compatibility work, not a claim that every game is playable. Games, keys, firmware, saves and original shader code are not included. Supply your own compatible game package and required keys. Import supports original package files and prepared folders; updates, DLC and unsupported package layouts remain limited.
The table records bounded launch observations on AYN Thor with the selected Balemuni Turnip driver and the candidate56 runtime. The current sweep sends no gameplay inputs. Later candidate57 checks are targeted regressions, not a fresh 58-game sweep. This table includes only games with a verified visible boot screen, notice, menu, intro or gameplay scene. Booting is not a gameplay pass. Earlier manual/saved-game evidence is shown separately. “Playable” below means only the previously tested initial scenes, not complete-title compatibility.
11 games shown below. See the complete testing report for all 58 entries, including failures and blocked launches, and the regression checks.
The runtime learns exact shader/pipeline recipes and prepares known combinations before gameplay. Bundled metadata catalogs cover 1,803 Link's Awakening records and 475 observed Echoes of Wisdom records. These are observed/imported lists, not whole-game coverage. First visits to unknown combinations can still stall. On a bounded Thor test, LAS preparation took about 71 seconds from an empty cache and about 5 seconds when cached. Preparation is separate from game loading and video playback. No comparison with another emulator is claimed.
A Fire Emblem shader local-memory optimization improved an earlier class demo from about 5–6 to 30 fps. It is a shared compiler optimization with specific proof conditions, not a universal speedup. Missing graphics, audio, services, package layouts and startup failures remain. See release notes .
Raitchi builds on the work of upstream authors and contributors. Their copyright, SPDX headers and license texts remain in adapted files and accompanying notices. Pinned revisions are recorded in sources.lock.json , echoes-source.lock.json and shell.lock.json .
Eden and its yuzu lineage: Android frontend and attributed runtime helpers; GPL-3.0-or-later components retain their notices.
LASRecomp , by Peiikai and contributors: original recomp/runtime lineage.
LASRecomp-Android-Plus : Android baseline and upstream LAS shader preparation records.
Let's Go Recomp : second-title runtime adaptations and references.
EoWRecomp : Echoes startup, service and graphics references, with LAS lineage credited in the upstream project.
BOTWRecompAndroid : architecture reference reviewed during development; no claim that its game support or entire implementation is included here.
SDL , FFmpeg , shaderc , Vulkan-Headers , volk , VulkanMemoryAllocator , AdrenoTools , LinkerNSBypass , Capstone , Dear ImGui and other dependencies identified in NOTICE.md .
Fredoka font authors and the attributed button-glyph generation work; notices accompany the font assets. Optional diagnostic dependencies have separate build options and licenses and are not implied to be default components.
Nintendo and game trademarks belong to their owners. Raitchi is not affiliated with or endorsed by Nintendo, Eden, or the upstream recomp projects.
